column1: #   Note: "aquatic plant protein" — complete AA profile, high lys (like legumes).
#         Digestibility ~75-80% (lower than insects)
#         Commercial strains (Lemnaceae) trending in Europe/SE Asia as protein crop.
# silkworm_pupae_dried — Bombyx mori, pupae, dried whole
#   Primary source: Hăbeanu et al. (2024) Insects 15(5):332 (PMC11122254)
#     Meta-review of ~16 studies
#   His EXCEPTION: Dataset C mean (6.63 ± 1.73) flagged as anomalous
#     (high inter-study variability, outlier studies drove the mean).
#     Cross-validated with Jeyaprakashsabari & Aanand 2008 (via PMC10051144):
#     2.6 g/100g protein × 0.6047 protein fraction = 1.57 g/100g DM.
#     Also consistent with Kumar et al. via Hăbeanu 2023 (2.5 → 1.51 g/100g DM).
#     His = 1.57 used here (conservative, cross-validated).
#   Note: EFSA has not issued a novel food opinion for Bombyx mori (June 2026).
#     FAO 2013 confirms it meets FAO/WHO/UNU EAA requirements. PDCAAS ≈ 0.86.
